detention.notes: No detention will be approved if driver is not tracking. No detention will be available if tracking is not on for the entire shipment, or if driver is late for pick up or delivery. The full $200 will take the place of a layover if required.

special_instructions.payment_terms: Pending all required paperwork is received by 12:00 PM EST, the load will be processed and sent to Triumph Pay within 48 hours.
